text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road clinches a brilliant 
victory in the Satsuki Sho! With her 
running, she answered everyone's soaring 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her joy was short-lived... Narita 
Top Road felt an unspeakable terror at the 
overwhelming intimidation exuded by "her."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—TM Opera O. Having shown a spirit-filled 
run, she proclaimed that in the end, the 
King would conquer all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the Japanese Derby (Tokyo 
Yushun). Against her idolized star and the 
unveiled Supreme Overlord, Narita Top Road 
steps up to challenge them once again!
